mentions.name: Hard SciFi novel
mentions.description: A hard science fiction novel project that deliberately avoids magic technology geniuses and magical aliens arriving to save the day. It is pursued through reading, thinking, research, and writing, under an honour pact after a spec fic author friend challenged the author to finally write the novel.
mentions.problem: How to write a Hard SciFi novel that does not have magic technology genius, and certainly not magic ET showing up to save the day
mentions.source_excerpt:
Read/Think/Research/Write: How to write a Hard SciFi novel that does not have magic technology genius, and certainly not magic ET showing up to save the day?

A spec fic author friend is on my case about it, because he said "why the hell haven't you written your novel yet?" and I foolishly said "yeah why not? okay let me do it", and now I'm stuck in an honour pact. Write or die trying.
mentions.author: adityaathalye
